phase_prompt.label: Default
phase_prompt.summary: Initial chant with subtle bioluminescence and low geothermal hum.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: A dimly lit obsidian chamber, 30m wide, with a basalt altar at its center, etched with Ethiopian and Egyptian glyphs. Hooded figures chant softly, their iridescent ocular lenses glowing faintly blue. Bioluminescent spores drift in the air, casting a low amber glow. Crystalline conduits snake across the floor, channeling a gentle geothermal hum into the altar. The scene is photorealistic, cinematic, with tactile textures of weathered robes and basalt walls.
